name: ATOMTEX Multipurpose Dosimeter-Radiometers
summary: Modular instruments that accept interchangeable detection units, so one processing unit can measure gamma and neutron dose rate, surface contamination and sample activity.

specs.Description: Modular: X-ray, gamma and neutron dose, surface contamination and source search via probes
X-ray/gamma dose rate 30 nSv/h – 300 µSv/h; Cs-137 activity; alpha/beta with BDPS-02
As AT1125 with extended range up to 100 mSv/h
Neutron and gamma dose-rate measurement with GPS-linked logging
